headline: US Federal Reserve Expected to Hold Interest Rates Steady Ahead of Midterms
summary: The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its final rate-setting meeting before the midterm elections, maintaining rates at one of the highest pre-election levels in over 20 years following last month's rate hike.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions dictate benchmark borrowing costs across global financial markets, influencing equity valuations, bond yields, and currency exchange rates.

impacts.name: US Banking
impacts.why: Holding interest rates steady maintains existing net interest margin environments for commercial lenders.

why_moved: A decision to hold interest rates steady aligns with market expectations, preventing sudden repricing in debt instruments and equity indices.
